fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the registration of a debugger for a program that is available in the logon screen (sticky key backdoor).
fields.name: Suspicious Debugger Registration Cmdline
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "sethc.exe" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "utilman.exe" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "osk.exe" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "magnify.exe" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "narrator.exe" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "displayswitch.exe" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "atbroker.exe" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "HelpPane.exe")))
